app: In the Slack workspace admin (https://{team}.slack.com/admin) go to Settings & permissions > Authentication and choose Configure next to SAML authentication (custom SAML needs a paid plan).
Paste the public certificate from {idp_cert_url} - Slack wants the base64 body between the BEGIN/END lines (check your app's current UI).
Expand Advanced options if offered: leave 'AuthnRequests signed' off, and choose whether the whole response or only the assertion must be signed - this template signs both, so either works.
Save, then use Test Configuration before requiring SSO for the workspace.
flareid: Add a SAML service provider (Admin > Applications > SAML service providers > New) and apply this template.
Replace {team} in the ACS URL with the workspace subdomain - the entity ID is https://slack.com for every workspace.
Keep NameID format emailAddress: Slack identifies members by email, which is also what the first_name/last_name attributes personalize.
Both 'Sign the Response' and 'Sign the Assertion' stay on - Slack accepts either, and signing both is what most IdPs ship.
